Because the document contrasts annual (Silver and Bronze) with irregular (Gold) awards, draw a simple bar chart in your mind or on paper. Use one bar for annual awards (Silver and Bronze) and a separate bar for Gold, with labels showing the change in interval. This visual contrast reinforces the structural difference in award schedules and helps distinguish between the categories.

##Use a three-column table to map medal types to award frequency and timing  
Structure a table with columns for Medal Type (Gold, Silver, Bronze), Award Frequency, and Award Timing. Fill in the specific details from the document. This format leverages the document’s categorical structure, allowing you to compare and contrast the three medals side-by-side, reinforcing distinctions in frequency and annuality.
